model: One-dimensional N-particle Hamiltonian with pair potential (1/(2N)) sum_{i<j}(q_i-q_j)^2; iid standard Gaussian phase points.
norms: W2 on the indicated Euclidean marginal

claims.statement: The normalized phase-space marginals satisfy the displayed BBGKY equation, and the limiting Vlasov equation with initial gamma=N(0,I_2) has the stationary solution gamma.
dependencies: Gaussian tails for marginal integration by parts
claims.cost: One exact Liouville marginalization; no discretization or numerical solver.

claims.statement: For every 1<=k<=N and real t, the k-phase covariance is I_{2k}+(1/N)J_k tensor [[t^2,t],[t,0]], with exact W2 cost given in RESULT.txt; its q-position projection is N(0,I_k+(t^2/N)J_k) with exact W2 sqrt(1+k t^2/N)-1.
claims.cost: Exact covariance diagonalization; at |t|<=T the q-position error is at most kT^2/(2N) and full phase-space error is at most C_T k/N.

claims.statement: Uncentered propagation of chaos is not uniform in time or over all levels k<=N: at t=sqrt(N), the bounded 1-Lipschitz observable cos(q) has a fixed nonzero one-body gap; at fixed t>0 and k/N->alpha>0 the raw block W2 has positive limit.
claims.falsifier: A direct contradiction to the covariance identity or to the expectation formula exp(-1/2)(1-exp(-t^2/(2N))) would falsify this claim.

claims.statement: After subtracting the empirical center of mass in q and p, the k-centered phase-space Gaussian has covariance (I_k-J_k/N) tensor I_2 and W2 distance sqrt(2)(1-sqrt(1-k/N)) to gamma tensor k, uniformly in all time.
dependencies: centered variables are defined from the full N-particle state
claims.scope_limit: Centered variables remain dependent; this is a fixed-k marginal comparison, not independence of the centered N-tuple.

claims.statement: The pair covariance Cov(q_1,q_2)=t^2/N and the k=1 BBGKY conditional q_2 moment identify the first factorization term that prevents an all-time uncentered closure estimate.
dependencies: Gaussian conditional expectation formula in RESULT.txt
claims.cost: No unclosed hierarchy estimate is assumed; the two-body statistic is computed exactly.

sources.citation: W. Braun and K. Hepp, Commun. Math. Phys. 56(2), 101-113 (1977), DOI 10.1007/BF01611497.
sources.scope: Abstract reports 1/N Vlasov weak-star limit, molecular chaos, and Gaussian fluctuations; full text not read.

sources.citation: R. L. Dobrushin, Funct. Anal. Appl. 13(2), 115-123 (1979), DOI 10.1007/BF01077243.
sources.scope: Classical Vlasov-stability prior-art pointer only; no detailed theorem assertion imported.

sources.citation: M. Hauray and S. Mischler, J. Funct. Anal. 266(10), 6055-6157 (2014), DOI 10.1016/j.jfa.2014.02.030.
sources.scope: Abstract identifies quantitative relations between chaos notions for all N variables and a fixed finite number; no theorem imported.

global_status: scoped_exact_model_result; general BBGKY closure, quantum limit, novelty, and external validation not established
restart: Recheck the covariance and hierarchy independently; test a confining trap or non-Gaussian iid law; keep centered/uncentered and fixed-k/full-N norms distinct.
